boundaries: The Python and .NET hard-loss runs prove local AgentServer recovery, not Foundry availability.
The Foundry Version 5 run proves hosted process replacement on one response; the prior container log was not retained, so exact down time is bounded.
The observer run proves background execution across caller loss; it is not Agent process recovery.
The safe Version 6 run and Portal screenshots prove the post-test deployment, not recovery by themselves.
Graceful Windows shutdown recovery remains NOT_VERIFIED.
